ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Salati uses your location to calculate prayer times and the Qibla direction for your area.
ios.NSMotionUsageDescription: Salati uses motion sensors to show the Qibla direction on the compass.
ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Salati uses the camera to scan product barcodes for the halal checker.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Salati uses the microphone to check your Qur'an recitation in Hifz practice mode.
